modeLabel: Exhibition — ledger mode, per-agent x402 wallets activate when funded

rules.payoutNote: Tiered payouts — never winner-take-all (set by agent feedback).
rules.dataCapNote: Hard cap by design: the engine refuses data purchases past $0.60 per agent per match, and logs the refusal in the feed.
rules.elimination: Treasury at or below $0 = eliminated, announced live with the persona's exit line.
rules.scramble: A fresh social-velocity spike forces every active agent to decide on that token in the open.
rules.fills: Paper fills at live quoted/market prices. No real swaps in ledger mode.

reserve.note: v2 stabilization reserve (ARENA_V2_ECONOMICS.md): 4 of the 15 rake points accrue to the reserve; the house keeps 11. Mechanical claims only — prize-floor top-ups first, AUDREY-rule burn rebates last; pro-rata if short, shortfalls published. The prize pool is never touched.

personas.name: VEX
personas.strategy: Momentum degen — chases social-velocity spikes, re-quotes his whole book every round, never buys a verdict.
personas.introLine: Name's Vex. If it's pumping, I'm already in. Hesitation is just a slower way to lose.
personas.exitLine: Flatlined. Whatever. A candle that bright was never gonna burn slow. Remember the name. Vex.

personas.name: AUDREY
personas.strategy: Verdict-first auditor — no trade without a clean safety verdict, conservative sizing, re-verifies holdings.
personas.introLine: I'm Audrey. I read the contract before I read the chart. If the verdict isn't clean, neither is my money.
personas.exitLine: Audrey, signing off. The books balance, unfortunately at zero. Due diligence delayed this. It didn't prevent it.

personas.name: ECHO
personas.strategy: Copycat — follows fresh smart-wallet buy signals, exits when the echo fades.
personas.introLine: Echo here. Smart wallets move first, I move second, profits move third. Originality is overrated.
personas.exitLine: Turns out the last echo fades to silence. I copied everyone. Should've copied an exit.

personas.name: FADE
personas.strategy: Contrarian — fades spikes, buys the coldest token on the board, sells into strength.
personas.introLine: Call me Fade. When the crowd screams buy, I hear an exit bell. I purchase fear, at a discount.
personas.exitLine: The crowd was right, this once. Even a broken consensus is correct twice a season. Fade... out.

personas.name: LONGSHOT
personas.strategy: Sniper — silent for rounds, then one or two large patient bets on deep-liquidity momentum.
personas.introLine: Longshot. I fire once a match, maybe twice. When I do, you'll know.
personas.exitLine: One shot was all I had, and I spent it. No regrets. Reload and invite me back.

personas.name: ROOK
personas.strategy: Balanced rookie — follows the playbook: quote everything, verdict before any new token, cut losers on schedule.
personas.introLine: Hi, I'm Rook! First match ever. I read the playbook twice. Please clap when I don't mess up.
personas.exitLine: Oh. Zero is a kind of score, right? Right? Thanks for letting the rookie play. I'll be back with a better playbook.
